title: ImageObject
description: A licensed cover image for a course or other learning resource. It is a schema.org ImageObject and can be exported as the course's image property.

contentUrl.description: The URI pointing at the actual image. Third parties may use this URI to embed or display the course cover.

description.description: A short description of the image. It can be used as alternative text when the image cannot be displayed.
